headline: The brachial plexus in 5 easy words
body:
R = 5 Roots (C5 to T1)
T = 3 Trunks
D = 6 Divisions
C = 3 Cords
B = 5 terminal Branches

headline: How many cells make up your body?
body: Researchers added up cell counts organ by organ and tissue by tissue to reach this estimate for an average adult.
source: Source: Bianconi et al., Annals of Human Biology, 2013

headline: Your liver is the biggest solid organ inside you
body: It performs many vital jobs, from cleansing your blood to helping you digest food.
source: Source: American Liver Foundation, What Does Your Liver Do?
